CLAMP.stands_in_for: the logic rail at the top of the regulator's accuracy plus the clamp diode's datasheet forward voltage, as an ideal source: a diode is not a linear element and the rail it clamps to is held by the regulator

FIELD.stands_in_for: the field terminal at the declared maximum, as an ideal source

RCLAMP.stands_in_for: the clamp's dynamic resistance, small enough that the node sits at the declared clamp level; the datasheet states none

RLOWER.stands_in_for: the lower divider element at the top of its tolerance

RSERIES.stands_in_for: the series element that bounds injection, at the bottom of its tolerance

RUPPER.stands_in_for: the upper divider element at the bottom of its tolerance, which drives the most into the clamp

description: one field input at the declared maximum with its clamp to the logic rail conducting, and what the controller pin sees
name: field_input_at_the_top_of_its_declared_range
